description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'ext_eapm' used for connecting to external API sources via EAPM details in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods to set and get the EAPM object, and relies on an external base class.

classes.name: ext_eapm
classes.description: An abstract class representing a generic external API connection source using EAPM access details, extending the 'source' base class.

methods.name: setEAPM
methods.description: Sets the ExternalAPIBase object ($eapm) used by this connector.

methods.name: getEAPM
methods.description: Retrieves the current ExternalAPIBase object set in this connector.
